set.body: Full roadmap P2 remains open. Add an explicit successor account wire version sharing existing primitives and validation; preserve legacy dumps/IDs/recorded prompts through explicit upgrade, never lossy downgrade. First bounded graph extension: states with context/evidence, location references to existing entities, evidenced temporal/manner circumstances with no invented interpreted clock. Include recorded construction, checked pairing of every collection and a real situation/circumstance table consumer. Audit legacy extraction/alignment/project to refuse unsupported new inputs or explicitly preserve all fields. Full polarity/modality, playback, richer relation/hierarchy and source/recall graph obligations remain owed. Design consultation favors distinct wire envelope over conditional serialization of legacy Account; implementation contract still needs fixture-driven decision.
set.title: P2.4 Add checked state and circumstance construction in a versioned rich account
